title: Plans
description: Optional plans for people who use TasksNearMe often. Everything works without one.

free.title: Without a plan
free.body: Posting, offers, booking, messages, safety, saved searches with alerts, and writing help are all free. You also get {count, plural, one {# AI search} other {# AI searches}} a month.

plus.name: Plus
plus.rebate: {share} of the client service fee back on every completed booking, up to {cap} a month
plus.ai: {count, plural, one {# AI search} other {# AI searches}} a month: describe what you need and get matching helpers and tasks
plus.breakEven: Pays for itself when you book about {amount} of tasks a month.

pro.name: Pro
pro.rebate: {share} of the helper fee back on every completed booking, up to {cap} a month
pro.ai: {count, plural, one {# AI search} other {# AI searches}} a month: describe the work you want and get matching tasks
pro.breakEven: Pays for itself when you earn about {amount} a month.

current.pastDue: Your last payment didn't go through. Stripe will try again; update your card in Manage to keep {plan}.

manageHint: Cancel, change your card or see invoices on Stripe's secure page.

estimate.plus: On your {count, plural, one {# booking} other {# bookings}} in the last 30 days, Plus would have paid back {amount}.
estimate.pro: On your {count, plural, one {# booking} other {# bookings}} in the last 30 days, Pro would have paid back {amount}.

aiSearch.remaining: {count, plural, one {# AI search} other {# AI searches}} left this month. They renew {date}.
aiSearch.used: No AI searches left this month. They renew {date}.
aiSearch.off: AI search isn't available right now. The regular search always works.

terms.title: Plain terms
terms.cancel: Cancel anytime. You keep the plan to the end of the period you paid for, and it doesn't renew.
terms.noTrial: No trial that turns into a charge, and no countdowns.
terms.price: The price you subscribe at stays until you cancel. A new price applies to new subscriptions only.
terms.trust: A plan never moves you up in lists or adds a badge. Reviews, checks and badges are earned the same way by everyone.
terms.rebates: Money back is paid when a booking is completed: to your card with Plus, with your earnings with Pro.

notices.subscribed: Thanks for subscribing. Your plan shows here as soon as Stripe confirms it, usually within a few seconds.
notices.checkout_canceled: You left checkout. Nothing was charged.

unavailable: Plans aren't open yet. Everything on TasksNearMe works without one.
error: That didn't work. If you already have this plan, refresh the page to see it.

pricing.title: Optional plans
pricing.intro: Everything above works without a plan. For people who book or help often, a plan pays part of the fee back each month, up to a cap.
